nodes.label: Spring Boot REST API (bodhassess-api-spring)
nodes.rationale: Spring Boot 2.5.5 on Java 11 with standard controller/service/repository layering, no JPA associations (plain String UUID columns, mostly client-supplied IDs), JSON columns via hibernate-types-52, and the deprecated WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter style kept deliberately - match it, don't modernize piecemeal.

nodes.label: React SPA (bodhassess-app)
nodes.rationale: React 19 + Vite 7 SPA where the @ alias resolves to the app root (not src/); roughly 37 of ~60 routes are static template mockups that never touch the API - the wired surface is dashboard, assessments, question-bank create/item-explorer, qualities, reports, admin, and portal.

nodes.label: run.sh Top-Level Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Only the top-level run.sh should be used - the nested bodhassess-api-spring/run.sh starts MySQL without Redis so heartbeat features fail; run.sh never sources the root .env, so host-run API and Vite only see exported variables.

nodes.label: Hand-Managed MySQL Schema (01-schema.sql)
nodes.rationale: ddl-auto=none so Hibernate never creates or migrates anything; the schema file runs only on first container init, and the established migration pattern is idempotent INFORMATION_SCHEMA count checks + PREPARE/EXECUTE ALTER blocks inside the same file - adding a column means editing CREATE TABLE and adding such a block.

nodes.label: PortalSession as Assessment Instance
nodes.rationale: 'Assessment' has no entity - AssessmentsController/Service/Dto all operate on PortalSession (portal_sessions), a respondent's assigned assessment instance with answers, mqt_scores, and demographics as JSON columns; distinct from the inert IRT-side Session entity.

nodes.label: Client-Side MQT Scoring
nodes.rationale: The backend never computes scores - mqt_scores and the score summary string are computed in the browser on the portal take page and PUT to the API, which persists them without validation.

nodes.label: Questionnaire Name as Business Key
nodes.rationale: Create dual-writes instruments and published_questionnaires rows with the same name, create dedupes by name (deleteOthersByName), catalog delete cascades across three tables by name, and the portal take page looks the questionnaire up by name - so renaming a published questionnaire breaks every pending assessment referencing the old name.

nodes.label: Dual Questionnaire Models (published_questionnaires vs instruments)
nodes.rationale: QuestionnairesService targets PublishedQuestionnaire while QuestionnairesCatalogService targets the instruments table via native SQL through EntityManager - the QuestionnaireCatalog entity and repository are dead code; 'instrument' and 'questionnaire/catalog' are used interchangeably.

nodes.label: Inert IRT/Adaptive Scaffolding
nodes.rationale: Session carries theta_estimate/trust_score, items has irt_a/b/c, instruments has is_adaptive/scoring_config - but no code computes theta or selects items adaptively; SessionsService is read-only native SQL, and tenants/users tables have no entity at all.

nodes.label: DOB-as-Credential JWT Auth
nodes.rationale: Stateless JWT with three user types (ADMIN/PRACTITIONER/RESPONDENT) and nobody has a password hash: admin is a single env-driven account with no DB row, practitioners and respondents log in with email-or-phone + date of birth; the token filter also accepts ?token= query params, and uploads plus questionnaire endpoints are deliberately public.

nodes.label: Heartbeat Polling Live Tracking
nodes.rationale: Pure polling, no WebSocket/SSE anywhere: the portal POSTs a heartbeat every 5s, HeartbeatService writes Redis keys heartbeat:<sessionId> with short TTLs (Redis's only use in the system), and the admin live-tracking page polls read-only endpoints.

nodes.label: Metronic 9 (KeenThemes) Template Base
nodes.rationale: Much of the template is unused (39 layout variants, only layout-1 used); leftover 'use client' directives and SSR guards are inert - don't propagate or strip them.

nodes.label: lib/api.ts Single API Client
nodes.rationale: Per-resource objects over a shared jsonFetch that throws on non-2xx; lib/data-store.ts re-exports these but swallows errors (lists return [], mutations return null), and its getSessions/getQuestionnaires/sessionsToReports are deliberate empty stubs - report pages render empty by design.

nodes.label: Portal Take Flow (src/pages/portal/take.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Where assessments actually happen: session id from ?id= query param, questionnaire fetched by name, disclaimer + demographics gates, heartbeats every 5s, first answer stamps started_at, submit computes all MQT scores in the browser and PUTs Completed - and if that final write fails the error is swallowed and the user still lands on /portal/complete.

nodes.label: Data-Driven Route Access (url_paths globs)
nodes.rationale: Roles carry url_paths glob patterns; canAccess() gates both PrivateRoute and the sidebar; admin is synthesized as a practitioner with url_paths ['/*'].

nodes.label: Three sessionStorage Auth Tokens
nodes.rationale: Practitioner, admin, and respondent tokens live under separate sessionStorage keys (never localStorage); the client attaches whichever exists in practitioner > admin > respondent priority, and practitioner/admin logins clear each other's token; portal pages bypass the auth provider and read sessionStorage directly.

nodes.label: Reverted 'sameer' Branch History
nodes.rationale: Branch sameer was merged then fully reverted, so commit messages advertise subsystems that do NOT exist in the working tree (Assessment entity, data-studio, unified auth, questionnaire versioning); trust the working tree, not git log - merging origin/sameer resurrects all of it as conflicts.
